_comment: Instance patterns for core/scripts/pending-clauses.py — phrases in YOUR rule language that make a sentence wait for a core state (the English ones are built in). Run by brain-update.sh after every pin move; a clause whose PR is already in the pinned core is reported STALE, any other pending clause as READ. Regexes, case-insensitive. Replace the examples with your language's phrases or delete the file.
